name: Damage Charts
author: zaxnyd
description: Incoming-damage forecast and damage analytics: see how much HP you're about to lose this turn (docked beside your character), plus a hotkey-toggled (default C) breakdown of damage dealt and taken by source, potions used, an end-of-combat summary and a run recap. Uses the game's own look. Share button on the victory and death screens (with Spire Sync 0.3.3+). Single-player and multiplayer.
